title: Mall dreams lately
content: I’ve been having what I can only describe as malls or hotels a lot in dreams lately. It’s not the same one over and over, so I’m not so sure my experiences belong here but I’m gonna share anyway. These dreams take place in huge buildings that are often bustling with people. I’m always with people who I used to go to school with or running into them and oftentimes I have this sense of “where’s my girlfriend?” As I’m describing this, it reminds me of a dream I had before my gf and I started dating and I was fwb with this guy and as we started to grow apart. It was similar, very crowded and some of the people being people I went to school with, except i began to search for him and it was throughout a city rather than just one big building. Has anyone had any similar dreams? What have you made of them?
